research_question: Do causally generated conditional-volatility forecasts improve out-of-sample risk prediction and exposure management across three Chinese A-share instruments?

CSI_300.historical_source: AKShare stock_zh_index_daily_em / EastMoney historical price index

SSE_Composite.historical_source: AKShare stock_zh_index_daily_em / EastMoney historical price index

ChiNext.historical_source: AKShare stock_zh_index_daily_em / EastMoney historical price index
ChiNext.legacy_symbol: 159915.SZ ETF proxy; retained unchanged in published 2015-2024 baseline only

raw_price: EastMoney index close, price-level series only (not total return)
price_adjustment_rule: All three v2.1 series are market price indices from one EastMoney interface. For price indices, research Close = raw Close; no ETF corporate-action adjustment or synthetic fill. Do not compare these as investable total returns.
decision_time: after market close at origin session t
training_rule: At any origin t, a sample is eligible only after its target_end_date <= t. Features must be measurable by close t.
target_comparison_rule: Evaluate the same target on identical origin and target timestamps for each model; report per-market and common-date panels.

validation.usage: chronological selection; legacy results already examined

new_holdout.usage: newly acquired post-legacy sample; freeze choices before fitting; not claimed guaranteed unseen

protocol_constraints: Never train on observations with target_end_date later than the current forecast origin.
For each window, include only observations whose target_end_date falls inside the same window.
No backfill of features, forecasts, returns or risk thresholds.
Do not replace or silently expand the six tracked legacy market CSVs.
Existing 2015-2024 results are legacy baselines and must not be described as untouched holdout.
No model-performance claims before a complete reproducible rerun.
data_readiness_reason: EastMoney index download must successfully return and validate three index histories through September 2026; no v2.1 forecasts have yet been fitted.
amendment_reason: Before any v2 model training or outcome reporting, replace the legacy 159915.SZ ETF proxy with the actual ChiNext price index 399006 (EastMoney sz399006), for a coherent three-price-index comparison. Yahoo Finance CSI history and EastMoney ETF-adjustment downloads failed on CI; the v2.1 approach avoids both mismatches.
